sources.title: Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5
sources.evidence: The June 9, 2026 announcement launches Claude Fable 5 for general use, identifies Mythos 5 as the same underlying model with different safeguards, and describes coding, knowledge-work, vision and long autonomous tasks.

sources.title: Claude Fable 5 - Claude Platform Docs
sources.evidence: Exact API ID claude-fable-5: June 9, 2026 release, 1M context, text/image input, text output, adaptive thinking always enabled, and hosted platform access. The current page marks this model active (legacy).

sources.title: PDF support
sources.evidence: All active models support PDF processing; PDFs are processed through text and vision capabilities. Together with the Fable 5 active status, this supports the catalog PDF input format.

sources.title: System Card: Claude Fable 5 & Claude Mythos 5
sources.evidence: Downloaded and text-inspected the 319-page first-party PDF in memory after the web reader rejected its size. Page 11 identifies identical underlying weights and text-only model output. The training section and parameter/architecture term searches disclose no production parameter counts or topology. Pages 177 and 192 discuss residual-stream steering and model layers; these are not parameter counts or a dense/MoE declaration.

sources.title: System Card: Claude Fable 5.1 & Claude Mythos 5.1
sources.evidence: Downloaded and text-inspected the 212-page later system card in memory. It compares Fable 5 in evaluations, but parameter and architecture searches reveal no Fable 5 total/active parameter table or production architecture specification. Parameter hits concern API thinking or effort controls.

sources.title: System Card: Claude Opus 5
sources.evidence: Downloaded and text-inspected the 194-page later card in memory. It contains comparisons with Fable 5 but no Fable 5 parameter count disclosure. Parameter hits concern API/evaluation controls; the architecture hit concerns a benchmark task.

sources.title: Prompting Claude Fable 5
sources.evidence: Exact-model documentation discusses tool calls, bash/crop tools, parallel subagents, and long-running coding and knowledge-work workflows. It explicitly gives a client-tool schema and instructions for Fable 5 to call it.

sources.title: Commercial Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Commercial terms govern Anthropic API services, grant service-use permission subject to restrictions, and prohibit reverse engineering or duplication. This supports proprietary licensing as a descriptive classification, not an open-weight license.

sources.title: Anthropic Transparency Hub - Claude Fable 5 Summary Table
sources.evidence: The exact Fable 5 entry describes text/image inputs, creative and analytical tasks, hosted access surfaces and training. Product-level voice dictation and text-to-speech are mentioned separately from the API model modalities. Its architecture section explains pretraining and post-training without disclosing topology or size.

sources.title: When AI builds itself
sources.evidence: Says current frontier models use Transformer architecture, but does not specifically identify Fable 5 topology. Treated as general context rather than sufficient evidence to assert an exact-model architecture.

sources.title: Models.dev Claude Fable 5 record
sources.evidence: Baseline source URL was opened as a discovery lead; technical conclusions use Anthropic sources rather than this catalog.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
sources.evidence: Anthropic explicitly states that Claude weights are not publicly released or provided to users. This is first-party evidence about weight availability independent of the existence of a hosted API; the paper's benchmark models are newer Claude versions.

name.note: Official launch name and exact API model agree.

developer.note: The developer announcement and system card identify Anthropic.

family.note: Normalized catalog family key for the named Claude Fable model line; not an architecture claim.

release_date.note: Earliest launch is explicitly June 9, 2026; later restoration of access is not a new release.

open_weights.note: Anthropic explicitly states Claude weights are not publicly released or provided to users. Exact Fable 5 sources document hosted proprietary distribution; no newer-model technical specifications are transferred.

license.note: Descriptive classification of the hosted model under Anthropic commercial terms; no named open-weight license is claimed.

parameters_b.note: No total production parameter count found in the accessed original card or later Fable 5.1 and Opus 5 cards, including exact-model comparisons. No third-party estimates adopted.

active_parameters_b.note: No active production parameter count is disclosed in the inspected cards. Neither dense activation nor an MoE routing count is assumed.

architecture.note: Original-card interpretability sections disclose layered residual-stream activations but not a precise architecture or dense/MoE topology. Exact-name searches of Anthropic research, alignment research and Transformer Circuits did not yield an explicit specification. The general Transformer statement in s10 is insufficient exact-model evidence.

modalities.note: API model accepts text and images and supports PDFs as an input document format. The card says model output is text only; product dictation/TTS does not add native audio modalities.

reasoning.note: Adaptive thinking is documented as always on.

tool_call.note: Exact-model prompting documentation describes and demonstrates client tool calling.

description.value: Claude model for coding, complex knowledge work, and long-running agent workflows, with additional safeguards for high-risk domains.
description.note: Replaces the generic creative-writing emphasis with the launch and API documentation positioning; safeguards are described without claiming guaranteed control or safety.

patch.description: Claude model for coding, complex knowledge work, and long-running agent workflows, with additional safeguards for high-risk domains.

patch.notes: Total and active parameter counts and exact architecture remain undisclosed in the inspected primary material, including later Fable 5.1 and Opus 5 cards. Fable 5 and Mythos 5 share model weights but differ in safeguards; fallback responses can come from another model.

summary: Confirmed model identity, June 9 launch, proprietary hosted access, 1M context, text/image/PDF inputs, text output, adaptive reasoning and tools. Added proprietary license classification and a more precise description. Kept total/active parameters and architecture unknown after original/later system-card checks and exact-model interpretability/training searches. PDFs were successfully read directly despite web-reader size errors; no live inference endpoint test was performed.
